sourceRules: Use official county, assessor/appraiser, GIS, municipal, state, or federal sources first.
Do not activate this county until exact parcel counts and join keys are verified.
Do not infer owner phone/email from permits, contractors, applicants, or scraped pages.
problemSolvingLoop: Discover official sources and preserve source dataset identifiers.
Audit schema, exact counts, geometry validity, nulls, and duplicate candidate keys.
Select a complete duplicate-safe feature identity and document secondary business identifiers.
Build a bounded-memory sample before attempting the full county snapshot.
Publish viewport chunks and search shards, then reconcile source, emitted, skipped, and joined counts.
Run county QC and keep visible activation disabled until every individual gate passes.

ownerEnrichment.sourceLabel: Harris County parcel/property FeatureServer and HCAD public data downloads
ownerEnrichment.propertyRecordSource: Official Harris County/Harris Central Appraisal District parcel/property attributes. The verified FeatureServer exposes owner, mailing, situs, legal, land, building, and value fields; HCAD public downloads remain the preferred production bulk handoff once selected.
ownerEnrichment.officialJoinKey: HCAD_NUM/acct_num -> White Rabbit accountNum; GlobalID is the unique GIS feature key
ownerEnrichment.noOfficialEmailFieldNote: No official owner email field was identified in the inspected Harris parcel/property layer. Do not infer owner email.

fields.businessName: owner_name_1 when the owner is an entity; do not infer entity type
fields.ownerPhone: No official owner phone field identified in inspected Harris parcel/property layer
fields.ownerEmail: No official owner email field identified in inspected Harris parcel/property layer

joinKeys.primaryParcelAccount: HCAD_NUM/acct_num -> White Rabbit accountNum; 5-row sample shows HCAD_NUM and acct_num matching for standard parcels
joinKeys.appraisal: HCAD_NUM/acct_num -> land_value, bld_value, impr_value, productivity_value, total_appraised_val, total_market_val, tax_value
joinKeys.land: HCAD_NUM/acct_num -> StatedArea, Acreage, acreage_1, land_sqft, land_use, state_class
joinKeys.secondaryParcelGisId: GlobalID is the unique GIS feature key; OBJECTID is service-local only
joinKeys.blockLabels: direct fields: BLK_NUM, LOT_NUM, legal_dscr_*, map_facet
joinKeys.dimensions: direct area/perimeter fields: Shape__Area, Shape__Length, land_sqft, Acreage; frontage/depth source-needed
joinKeys.permits: source-needed: official permit/CO source must be verified before address or spatial parcel join
joinKeys.zoning: source-needed: countywide zoning is fragmented; municipal zoning/overlays must be verified separately
joinKeys.floodplain: source-needed: FEMA/local floodplain parcel centroid spatial join keyed back to HCAD_NUM/acct_num
joinKeys.developmentSignals: source-needed: verified permit, plat, demolition, certificate, project, address, or spatial join evidence
joinKeys.migrationDemand: source-needed: aggregate geography join, not individual people

productionGap: Pilot adapter only. Official Harris parcel/property FeatureServer is verified with 1,535,525 parcel features; full viewport chunks, search shards, owner/appraisal joins, direct block/legal context, and parcel area/perimeter dimensions are built and QC-gated. Remaining DCAD-parity gaps are permit/CO joins, floodplain joins, zoning/overlay joins, development signals, migration demand, activation QA, and PMTiles.
pilotNotes: Do not activate this county in the app until exact duplicate key QA, parcel card QA, remaining intelligence joins, source-lineage reports, and activation review pass. Do not redesign any pages.
